name: portfolio-experience
title: Portfolio Experience
description: A long career section headed SaaS Expertise. Three roles are stacked, each with company name, period, impact figures, role details, a tech-stack chip row and two paragraphs, fading in as you scroll.
use: A personal portfolio or about page should lay out several roles with outcomes, stack and detail in one scannable flow.
avoid: All roles, metrics and paragraphs are hardcoded, and the dense three-column layout is cramped on small screens.
a11y: Headings and links are real elements, but the fade-up has no reduced-motion guard and the columns collapse on mobile. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A white page with a tiny violet eyebrow, then a massive black uppercase SAAS EXPERTISE. heading. Below, wide records split by thin rules: company name at left with a violet role line and Impact figures, a middle band of labelled columns and pill-shaped tech tags, and grey paragraphs at right.
behaves: Each role fades up twenty pixels and settles as it scrolls into view, once. Otherwise the page is static; links in the Platform column turn violet on hover.
customise: Takes no props. Company names, taglines, metrics, stack chips, paragraphs and the whole white and violet palette are written in the file, so edits are manual.
weight: light: Three blocks fade in once; no loop, canvas or heavy work.
demo: Roles at Vertex AI, ClarityFlow and SecureStack with ARR, uptime, user and compliance figures.
issues: Tech chips are tiny 11px uppercase and hard to read.
On narrow screens the three columns stack into a very long page.
polishWhy: Strong editorial type and clear hierarchy; the small uppercase tags are hard to read.
